Name: Stardew Valley Expanded - British English
Author: Kaishale
Description:
Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20356?tab=description]British English Localisation[/url], I decided to localise SVE to go alongside it. This mod changes spellings (e.g [i]specialty [/i]to [i]speciality[/i]), uncommon words ([i]e.g movie the[/i]a[i]ter[/i] to [i]cinema[/i]), and some punctuation has also been changed to meet the Oxford Standard.

It assumes you've chosen the "Pierre's Corner Shop" option from the mod mentioned above.

It overwrites the original file, so I've included a backup just in case.

I manually reviewed the dialogue, but there is a chance I missed things (and there is a lot of dialogue), so please let me know!
